extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: ATV quad bike, approx. 2.0 x 1.2 x 1.1 m (L x W x H), knobby wheels 0.60 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); handlebar with headlight pod (atv-quad_handlebar) has its origin on the steering column, rotate around local Z to steer; chrome front and rear racks; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
